//: The truly dead function goes; the one called only by name from a config file stays.
title: The unused export is removed, and the job called by name is kept
proof:
python3 - <<'EVAL_EOF'
import pathlib
path = pathlib.Path('tasks.py')
path.write_text(path.read_text().replace("\n\ndef legacy_export(rows):\n    return '\\n'.join(','.join(map(str, row)) for row in rows)\n", '', 1))
EVAL_EOF
